metadata.title: Why 2% Truly Rule The World #Shorts
metadata.description: The uncomfortable psychological laws behind power, money, and influence. Which law hits hardest? Comment the number. #Shorts #DarkPsychology #PsychologyFacts

audio_profile.recommended_voice_style: deep male authoritative, calm and menacing
audio_profile.bg_music_vibe: slow dark techno beat with deep sub bass

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Ninety eight percent of people go their whole lives never learning these four laws.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: silhouette businessman overlooking city night skyline dramatic

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Law one. Perception is reality. Nobody sees your effort. They see your image.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: mirror reflection man suit abstract cinematic moody

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Never argue your worth. Let results do the talking. Quietly.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: chess board pieces dramatic lighting close up slow motion

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Law two. Silence is power. The person speaking less is controlling the frame.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: dark room single chair spotlight minimal dramatic slow

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Reveal less. Unread people cannot be predicted. Unpredictable people cannot be used.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: shadowy figure fog street lamp night cinematic moody

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Law three. Scarcity creates value. Anything too available becomes invisible.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: diamond rotating macro black background luxury slow

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Be harder to reach. Watch your worth climb the moment you withdraw.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: golden door closing dark hall dramatic cinematic slow

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Law four. Never announce your moves. Announced plans die in other people's mouths.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: lips whispering macro dark moody cinematic slow motion

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Move in silence. Shock them with results. Which law hit hardest? Comment it. Follow.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: golden crown dark velvet background cinematic macro slow
